cards.ex: The government is under pressure to open up markets to foreign competition.
cards.exUz: Hukumat xorijiy raqobatga bozorlarni ochish uchun bosim ostida.
cards.uzDef: Chet el kompaniyalari uchun savdo qilish imkoniyatini yaratmoq.

cards.ex: The US imposed trade sanctions on the country due to human rights violations.
cards.exUz: AQSh inson huquqlari buzilganligi sababli davlatga savdo sanksiyalari qo'ydi.

cards.ex: The company's global reach has expanded significantly in recent years.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning global qamrovi so'nggi yillarda sezilarli darajada kengaydi.

cards.ex: Lowering taxes is expected to boost the economy.
cards.exUz: Soliqlarni kamaytirish iqtisodiyotni ko'tarishi kutilmoqda.

cards.ex: Investing in a volatile market can be risky.
cards.exUz: O'zgaruvchan bozorga sarmoya kiritish xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Increased competition is driving down prices for consumers.
cards.exUz: Raqobatning kuchayishi iste'molchilar uchun narxlarni tushirmoqda.

cards.ex: Some accuse developed countries of using developing nations as a dumping ground for their waste.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilar rivojlangan davlatlarni o'z chiqindilari uchun rivojlanayotgan davlatlardan chiqindi joyi sifatida foydalanishda ayblashadi.

cards.ex: As the tariff war escalates, businesses are feeling the pressure.
cards.exUz: Boj urushi kuchayishi bilan bizneslar bosimni his qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Boj urushi davom etmoqda va vaziyat yomonlashmoqda.

cards.ex: Many fear that the current economic situation could lead to a global recession.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik hozirgi iqtisodiy vaziyat global retsessiyaga olib kelishi mumkinligidan xavotirda.

cards.ex: The price of oil is largely determined by supply and demand.
cards.exUz: Neft narxi asosan taklif va talab bilan belgilanadi.

cards.ex: The two countries signed a new trade agreement to reduce tariffs.
cards.exUz: Ikki davlat bojxona to'lovlarini kamaytirish uchun yangi savdo shartnomasini imzoladi.

cards.ex: The country was accused of currency manipulation to gain a trade advantage.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat savdo afzalliklariga erishish uchun valyuta manipulyatsiyasida ayblangan.

cards.ex: International trade has increased dramatically in recent decades.
cards.exUz: Xalqaro savdo so'nggi o'n yilliklarda keskin oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Davlatlar o'rtasidagi tovarlar va xizmatlar savdosi.

cards.ex: Economic integration can lead to greater prosperity and stability.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy integratsiya yanada farovonlik va barqarorlikka olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The trade imbalance between the two countries is a major concern.
cards.exUz: Ikki davlat o'rtasidagi savdo nomutanosibligi asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.

cards.ex: The company is focusing on expanding its share of the domestic market.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ichki bozordagi ulushini kengaytirishga e'tibor qaratmoqda.

cards.ex: Emerging economies are becoming increasingly important players in the global economy.
cards.exUz: Rivojlanayotgan iqtisodiyotlar global iqtisodiyotda tobora muhim rol o'ynamoqda.

cards.ex: Global competition is forcing companies to innovate and improve efficiency.
cards.exUz: Global raqobat kompaniyalarni innovatsiyalar yaratishga va samaradorlikni oshirishga majbur qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Butun dunyo bo'ylab kompaniyalar o'rtasidagi raqobat.

cards.ex: High startup costs can be a significant barrier to entry for new businesses.
cards.exUz: Yuqori ishga tushirish xarajatlari yangi bizneslar uchun sezilarli kirish to'sig'i bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yangi biznesning bozorga kirishini qiyinlashtiradigan omil.

cards.ex: The country has a large trade surplus with its neighbors.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat qo'shnilari bilan katta savdo profitsitiga ega.

cards.ex: Nike is a well-known global brand.
cards.exUz: Nike - mashhur global brend.

cards.ex: The pandemic caused significant supply chain disruptions worldwide.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya butun dunyo bo'ylab ta'minot zanjiri uzilishlariga olib keldi.

cards.ex: The US imposed economic sanctions on Russia.
cards.exUz: AQSh Rossiyaga iqtisodiy sanksiyalar qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Bir davlatga iqtisodiy bosim o'tkazish choralari.

cards.ex: Some argue that globalization leads to a race to the bottom in labor standards.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilar globalizatsiya mehnat standartlarida pastga poygaga olib keladi, deb ta'kidlaydi.

cards.ex: Companies need to understand the dynamics of the global market to succeed.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun global bozor dinamikasini tushunishlari kerak.

cards.ex: Many companies are outsourcing jobs to countries with lower labor costs.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina kompaniyalar ish o'rinlarini mehnat xarajatlari past bo'lgan mamlakatlarga autsorsing qilmoqda.

cards.ex: The government imposed import tariffs on steel.
cards.exUz: Hukumat po'latga import bojxonasini joriy qildi.

cards.ex: The government is trying to protect domestic industries from foreign competition.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ichki sanoatni xorijiy raqobatdan himoya qilishga harakat qilmoqda.

cards.ex: Consumers are increasingly demanding sustainable trade practices.
cards.exUz: Iste'molchilar tobora barqaror savdo amaliyotlarini talab qilmoqdalar.

cards.ex: The global economy is facing many challenges.
cards.exUz: Global iqtisodiyot ko'plab muammolarga duch kelmoqda.
